{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the number of patients after deduplication
n_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Compute response rate by site
df_response_rate = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
best_site = df_response_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = df_response_rate.max()

# Print results
df_response_rate, best_site, best_rate, n_patients"}
